{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm (only 2 rows)
filtered_df = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Check if missing 'sex' values are associated with flipper length
# Compare mean flipper length between observed and missing 'sex' within each species
sex_missing_mask = df['sex'].isnull()
sex_observed_mask = ~sex_missing_mask

# For each species, compare mean flipper length between those with and without sex recorded
comparison = filtered_df.groupby('species').apply(
    lambda x: {
        'mean_flipper_observed': x.loc[x['sex'].notnull(), 'flipper_length_mm'].mean(),
        'mean_flipper_missing': x.loc[x['sex'].isnull(), 'flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    }
)

# Display the comparison
comparison"}
